quests.title: The Lost Wizard of Hometown
quests.description: The townsfolk whisper of an eccentric mage who dwells nearby. Find Uncle Wiz in the Old House and uncover what mysteries he guards.

quests.title: The Shelves of Knowledge
quests.description: Uncle Wiz has directed you toward his library. Seek the shelf of wisdom and study one of his ancient tomes.

quests.title: Book I – The Nature of Elements
quests.description: Through the pages of the first tome, learn to perceive and identify the fundamental elements that form all matter.

quests.title: Return to the Sage
quests.description: You’ve completed the first book. Return to Uncle Wiz and share the truths you’ve uncovered.

quests.title: Book II – The Art of Creation
quests.description: Delve into the second tome to master the alchemy of combining elements into powerful compounds.

quests.title: Return to the Sage
quests.description: Bring your newfound wisdom back to Uncle Wiz and await your next challenge.
Uncle Wiz has prepared a test at his 2nd Book shelf. Prove your understanding of the properties of matter.
quests.title: The Trials of Properties
Return to the Wizard
quests.description: Report to Uncle Wiz after conquering the Trials of Properties.

quests.title: Book III – The Mystery of Mixtures
quests.description: Travel to the map of knowledge and complete your third lesson to understand how elements mingle to form mixtures.

quests.title: Return to the Wizard
quests.description: Return to Uncle Wiz and share your insights about mixtures.

quests.title: The Table of Separation
quests.description: A new experiment awaits beneath the furniture—a table dedicated to unraveling the art of separating mixtures.

quests.title: Return to the Wizard
quests.description: Report to Uncle Wiz after mastering the Separation Table.

quests.title: Lesson IV – The Measure of Truth
quests.description: Study the difference between Accuracy and Precision at the newly revealed table of instruments.

quests.title: Return to the Wizard
quests.description: Share your newfound insight about precision and accuracy with Uncle Wiz.

quests.title: The Apprentice of the East
quests.description: Uncle Wiz speaks of his apprentice, Christofe. Seek him out in the Blacksmith to continue your training.

quests.title: Lesson V – The Weight of Matter
quests.description: Under Christofe’s guidance, study the principles of density—how mass and volume reveal the false measure of matter.

quests.title: Return to Christofe
quests.description: Return to Christofe to discuss your discoveries about density.

quests.title: Lesson VI – The Dance of Matter
quests.description: Christofe invites you to a new experiment table. Learn how matter shifts its form between solid, liquid, and gas.

quests.title: Return to Christofe
quests.description: Report to Christofe and reflect on what you’ve learned about the states of matter.
